latestVersion.changelog:
ai-selfie-openapi-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of an AI selfie generator that transforms a portrait into a natural iPhone-style selfie photo.
- Supports image uploads and natural language selfie scene instructions; generates up to 16 selfie images per request.
- Requires user API key, to be set via the WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Integrates with openapi.weshop.ai over secure HTTPS; provides clear security guidance on API key usage.
- Includes endpoints for job creation, status polling, and image uploading.
